approach.method_basis: NF-BO does Bayesian optimization in a latent space that is exactly invertible. A normalizing flow maps molecular sequences to continuous latents and back with no reconstruction error, so a point chosen in latent space decodes to a definite molecule rather than an approximation. A Gaussian process is fitted over the scored latents, Thompson sampling picks promising directions, and proposals are made by perturbing selected token blocks within a trust region before decoding back through the inverse flow.
approach.novelty: This root commits to choosing which token blocks to perturb by an estimated sequence-level pointwise mutual information rather than uniformly, so the perturbation concentrates on positions the flow considers informative. It also adapts the flow to high-scoring task-local sequences mid-session and re-encodes every observation after each adaptation, which keeps the latent geometry aligned with the current objective instead of frozen at corpus statistics.

observed_bottleneck: This root has no Parent or evaluated NF-BO node. The benchmark provides few scored starting molecules and short task-local feedback, so a useful latent optimizer must preserve the identity and labels of observed structures while producing novel nearby molecules that its posterior can distinguish. The supplied results for other paradigms do not establish flow reconstruction, token importance, or latent predictive usefulness. The bound proposal tests these prerequisites before attributing any final Top-1 benefit to local inverse-flow search.
hypothesis: Search around scored task-local molecules in an injective SELFIES SeqFlow latent space, adapt the flow to high-scoring observations, and use a latent GP with Thompson sampling to select fresh trust-region proposals whose perturbed token blocks are chosen from estimated sequence-level PMI before exact inverse-flow decoding.

finding_summary.headline: The only root to fail: the flow adaptation aborted mid-run and two objectives never finished
finding_summary.insights: The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.
finding_summary.results: The node is recorded buggy with no macro score, and its mechanism is refuted. Three objectives completed their full 290 proposals, but drd2_docking stopped at 140 accepted molecules and median_2 at 230, in both cases when a flow adaptation aborted. Of 129 adaptation attempts only 127 completed. The components that did run checked out: corpus pretraining moved held-out token loss from 15.283 to -3.877, exact left-inverse decoding held with a maximum error of 7.7e-07 at the selected checkpoint, all 840 pointwise mutual information estimates were nondegenerate, and every one of the 124 completed batches emitted exactly the announced ten valid novel molecules.

molecular.headline: Boron, phosphorus and cumulated double bonds: latent perturbation decodes to chemistry that does not exist
molecular.overall_character: This is the most chemically implausible output in the round. Cumulated double bonds, essentially absent from every other root, appear in 42 percent of proposals on one objective and 95 percent on another. Boron appears as a terminal double-bonded atom, phosphorus appears as cationic chains, and charged species reach 88 percent on one objective. Aromatic content runs 31 to 66 percent, and one proposal reaches 239 characters. The exact-inverse property the method depends on is working correctly; the problem is that the latent neighbourhood being searched decodes to sequences that are valid SELFIES and impossible molecules.

per_task.generated_character: Half the proposals carry an aromatic atom and 42 percent contain a cumulated double bond, with 48 percent formally charged. One proposal runs to 239 characters, the longest in the round.
liabilities: terminal boron double bonds are not a real bonding pattern
cumulated double bonds in 42 percent of the population
missing_features: carbon-only backbones in place of boron and phosphorus termini
molecules under a hundred characters, with one proposal reaching 239
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The best reaches 0.359, which is mid-field for this objective, on a pyrrole carboxamide whose tail ends in a phosphorus cation. The zero scorers are boron-terminated polyene chains carrying long alkyl runs, which is the failure mode this representation keeps producing.

per_task.generated_character: The most conventional set on this node and the only one that mostly reads as chemistry: methoxylated aryl aminals averaging forty characters, though 21 percent close no ring and 13 percent still carry cumulated double bonds.
liabilities: aminal groups joining two nitrogens to one carbon hydrolyse readily
an anionic boron appears substituted into an aromatic ring in one top scorer
missing_features: a minimum molecular size, with proposals as small as two heavy atoms
stable alternatives to the aminal linkage that dominates the top scorers
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The top four cluster between 0.569 and 0.575 on one trimethoxyaryl aminal scaffold, while the bottom of the range is occupied by tiny fragments such as fluoromethane and a six-atom allene, both scoring the floor value of 0.5.

per_task.generated_character: Truncated at 140 accepted molecules when the run aborted. Charged species reach 88 percent and halogens 99 percent, with proposals averaging seventy-five characters built around cationic sulfur and anionic boron in the same ring.
liabilities: cationic sulfur triple bonds and anionic boron in ring systems are not real
selenium cation substituents appear among the proposals
missing_features: neutral molecules, with 88 percent of proposals carrying a formal charge
the remaining 150 oracle calls, which the abort consumed
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The best reaches 0.652 from only 140 oracle calls, which is a better rate than several roots that used all 300. The top two are identical apart from one ring atom, and both carry a dichlorophenyl next to a pyrrolidine, which is the kind of feature that scores on this objective. The chemistry around it is not viable.

per_task.generated_character: Truncated at 230 accepted molecules when the run aborted. Ethyl benzoates fused to pyrimidinediones averaging fifty-five characters, with 57 percent formally charged and 66 percent aromatic.
liabilities: hypervalent sulfur substituted into aromatic ring positions
conjugated polyene chains terminating in thioesters and phosphorus cations
missing_features: the remaining 70 oracle calls, which the abort consumed

per_task.score_gradient_reading: The best reaches 0.171 from 230 calls rather than 300, comparable to roots that used the full budget. The top four are one scaffold with the ring heteroatom varied, and several substitute a hypervalent sulfur into a position where carbon belongs. The worst are conjugated polyene thioesters.

per_task.generated_character: The most extreme set on the node. Cumulated double bonds appear in 95 percent of the 290 proposals, boron in the top four molecules, and only 31 percent of proposals carry an aromatic atom while 37 percent close no ring at all.
liabilities: terminal boron double bonds are not a real bonding pattern
cationic phosphorus chains repeated a dozen times in one proposal
cumulated double bonds in 95 percent of the population
missing_features: carbon-only backbones in place of boron and phosphorus substitution
aromatic rings, present in under a third of proposals

per_task.score_gradient_reading: Despite the chemistry the best reaches 0.342, higher than nine of the twelve roots managed on this objective, while the median is 0.0004. The top four are the same boron-substituted pyrrole amide with the phosphorus terminus varied, which means the score is being driven by a scaffold the flow cannot express cleanly.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Cumulated double bonds appear in 42 percent of proposals on one objective and 95 percent on another, against under 1 percent for every root that completed successfully.
transferable_gaps.gap: latent perturbation decodes into cumulated double bonds at extreme rates
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The token vocabulary treats successive double bonds as an ordinary continuation, so a small move in latent space can insert one anywhere. Penalising or removing those tokens from the perturbable set would cost nothing the search actually needs.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Terminal boron double bonds appear in the highest-scoring molecules on one objective, cationic phosphorus chains repeat within a single proposal, and selenium cations appear as substituents.
transferable_gaps.gap: the generator decodes to boron, phosphorus and selenium species
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The corpus alphabet retains exotic heteroatoms that are legal in the sequence encoding and absent from usable chemistry. Restricting the decodable alphabet is a preparation-time change that does not touch the flow or the surrogate.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Two objectives terminated early, one at 140 of 300 accepted molecules and one at 230, when a flow adaptation aborted; 127 of 129 adaptation attempts completed and the two failures ended those sessions.
transferable_gaps.gap: adapting the representation inside the live evaluation loop can cost the remaining budget
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A training step placed inside the oracle loop turns any numerical failure into lost budget rather than a lost step. Adaptation belongs at a batch boundary with a guarded fallback to the previous representation, so a failed update degrades to no update.

method_name: NF-BO: invertible sequence-flow search with token-adaptive latent proposals
method_thesis: Use NF-BO's SeqFlow mapping, exact left-inverse decoding, and token-adaptive trust-region search. Train a compact SELFIES flow on the permitted unlabeled corpus. Within each fresh objective session, adapt it using highly scored task-local sequences, re-encode all observations after updates, and fit a latent-space GP. Generate new latent proposals around scored observations by perturbing token blocks according to their estimated pointwise mutual information with the decoded sequence. Thompson sampling selects proposals for inverse-flow decoding. These mechanisms follow [NF-BO, Sections 4 and 5.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.14889v1). Regenerate as needed to fill the evaluator-announced batch with distinct canonical molecules; no corpus molecules are ranked or retrieved. The hypothesis is that score-directed local search around exactly reconstructable observations finds improving structures efficiently enough to raise the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores. Exact reconstruction alone is not the objective. Useful flow training and surrogate prediction under the permitted preparation and feedback remain empirical prerequisites.
